title: Shoei RF-1400 Complete Interior Liner Set
features: Complete replacement set includes Center Pad, Left/Right Cheek Pads, and Ear Pad Inserts
Shoei proprietary 3D Max-Dry moisture-wicking and quick-drying antimicrobial fabric
Restores factory-snug helmet crown fit and acoustic dampening to original spec
Fully removable and machine washable on gentle cycle
description:
Designed to optimize interior helmet ergonomics and temperature regulation, the Shoei RF-1400 Complete Interior Liner Set from Shoei keeps riders dry, focused, and comfortable across grueling saddle stints. Built with Hydrophilic Moisture-Wicking Core with Fast-Evaporating Air-Mesh Outer, it boasts an installation rating of 1.0 / 10 (Direct snap-tab alignment into EPS cheek-pad / liner channels).

Engineered for all-season comfort, the Shoei RF-1400 Complete Interior Liner Set from Shoei delivers exceptional moisture management and skin comfort, shielding riders from biting wind-chill and summer humidity.
